title: 70,300 परमाणु हथियार 12,187 कैसे बने? | How 58,000 Nuclear Weapons Disappeared | Hindi Documentary
description:
उन्नीस सौ छियासी में दुनिया में क़रीब 70,300 परमाणु हथियार थे। आज क़रीब 12,187। यानी 58,000 हथियार ग़ायब हो गए। कैसे? ये इंसानी इतिहास की सबसे बड़ी, और सबसे कम जानी गई सफ़ाई की पूरी कहानी है।

In 1986 the world had about 70,300 nuclear weapons; today about 12,187. This documentary tells how 58,000 disappeared: the 1983 war scares, Reykjavik, the INF Treaty, the fall of the Soviet Union, Ukraine and the Budapest Memorandum, Nunn-Lugar, South Africa, Megatons to Megawatts, how bombs are taken apart at Pantex, and the end of New START in 2026.

📊 Key numbers
• US stockpile peak: 31,255 (1967) · Soviet peak: 40,159 (1986)
• INF Treaty: 2,692 missiles destroyed by 1991
• 1991 presidential initiatives: ~17,000 tactical weapons withdrawn (NTI estimate)
• Nunn-Lugar: 7,616 Soviet-era warheads deactivated (by 2013)
• Megatons to Megawatts: 500 t of weapons uranium ≈ 20,000 warheads → ~10% of US electricity for ~20 years
• US dismantled 12,088 warheads (1994–2023); only 69 in 2023
• Doomsday Clock: 17 minutes (1991) → 85 seconds (2026)
